source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Once per battle, as the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) begins, this model may call on its psychic familiar. Its Cosmic Horror ability then gains 6" of range until that phase ends.

Keep a Psychic Familiar token beside the model until the ability is used.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
